info.text:
Free college money can still show up on your tax return.

Scholarships (usually merit) and grants (usually need) generally don't have to be repaid. Work-study is a paycheck: at least minimum wage for hours worked.
The max federal Pell Grant is $7,395 for 2026-27, unchanged since 2023-24.
Undergrads averaged $12,080 in grant aid per full-time-equivalent student in 2024-25 (College Board).
IRS rule: scholarship money used for housing counts as taxable income. Example: $3,000 of a $10,000 scholarship spent on housing counts as income.

Sources: US Dept. of Education; College Board Trends in Student Aid 2025; IRS Publication 970.
News and education, not financial advice.
